text: A white workbench viewed from above. In the centre sits a square white tray with raised walls, open on top; inside it lies a flat white insert holding a small rack or block of green-and-white components arranged in two short rows. To the right of the tray is a narrow white rectangular holder or rail with slots, empty. Black cables enter from the lower right corner. At the left edge is an instrument with a green/blue keypad and a red seven-segment display reading "97.0"; a small square barcode/AprilTag marker lies beside it. Behind the bench stands an aluminium-profile gantry frame. In the background are a blue vacuum pump, a black rack holding red- and green-capped tubes, and white cabinets on a grey floor.
